# Fixture log for the FALSE GREEN of run 34023334942 — NOT a real sweep.
#
# On 2026-09-06 the first full chunked sweep concluded SUCCESS with every job
# green, while its own concatenated log carried 62 FAIL rows. Two independent
# defects had to line up for that:
#
#   1. the group step piped y4d-spec into `tee` under a shell that is
#      `/usr/bin/bash -e` — no `pipefail` — so the pipeline's status was tee's
#      (always 0) and `|| status=$?` never fired. Group job 101459896772
#      printed `FAIL fasteners: parity …` twice and still concluded success.
#   2. the report job took its verdict from the matrix result alone, computing
#      the FAIL-row count for DISPLAY only, and called the reporter --green.
#
# This fixture reproduces the shape exactly, at fixture scale: TWO groups, the
# scope fully covered (so the completeness check is satisfied and cannot be the
# thing that catches it), every group "succeeded" as far as any exit code is
# concerned — and ONE cartridge with FAIL rows, in the second group, followed
# by a green cartridge, which is what last-writer-wins would have hidden.
#
# A reporter handed this log with --green must REFUSE: report the red, list the
# rows in the tracking issue, exit 1. That is the whole regression.
#
# The parity rows mirror `fasteners`' real ones (run 34023334942, group job
# 101459896772) so the fixture asserts against the shape the sweep actually
# emits. The slugs are deliberately fake (`fixture-*`): no cartridge in this
# repo is named that, so an issue raised from this file cannot be mistaken for
# a real failure.
